name: UI Colors
summary: Tailwind CSS color generator: build an 11-shade scale from one color and preview it on UI components.
description: Create, edit, save and share Tailwind CSS color scales from a base hex or HSL color, add brand, neutral and status scales, and preview them on cards, websites, dashboards, charts, gradients and shadcn/ui components. Also offers a palette generator with color-scheme and lock modes, browsable pages for each Tailwind color, an API that returns a 50-950 scale in hex and HSL from one hexcode, and a Figma plugin.
contains: 11-shade scales generated from one base color
color previews on cards, websites, dashboards, charts and shadcn/ui components
brand, neutral and status color scales
API returning a 50-950 scale in hex and HSL
